item: OSM geography: choropleths by country and by admin-1 region (v0.6.0 B3c, S06-01 S4)
key_paths: src/osm/geography.py; src/osm/completeness.py; src/osm/trends.py; src/osm/profile.py; src/api/osm_lane.py; src/static/app-map.js; src/static/index.html; tests/test_osm_geography.py; tests/osm_geography_node_test.js; tests/test_osm_geography_ui.py
summary: A new panel under the World map tab draws the lane's places on the existing Equal Earth map, by country (GET /api/osm/geography) or by admin-1 region of any counted country, with one measure at a time: places with metadata, carrying brand or brand:wikidata, carrying a check_date, last edited within a year of the vintage, or (countries only) with a tag changed in the window observed on this machine. The count or the share of the area's own places is the colour; the full ranked table sits beside every map and agrees with it; every country's own vintage (extract date and newest change file applied) is stated on the map; areas the lane does not hold are hatched as no data, never zero; no score, threshold or coverage bar. Region measures are stored per region when the split is counted (an older split reads as counted-before-this-measure, never zero); a change row carries its country, not its region, so the changed measure is not drawn by region and the page says so. Also: the history-prior queries of B3a/B3b now anti-join through a per-call TEMP table of event versions, about five times faster at 12M history rows (317 s to 45 s measured). Chromium-verified in en, ar (RTL) and zh at 375 px.
